new_counterhypothesis.name: FRESH_REPLACEMENT_RUNTIME_TOOLING_GAP

new_counterhypothesis.falsifier_or_fix: Make replacement runtime prerequisites explicit and reproducible, or use an independently admitted exact image-backed runtime path; never let snapshot inheritance silently supply Docker/tooling.
